summary: Derived the two-minus A_n closed form analytically from the Berends-Giele recursion. Ported bg.cpp to Python (exact-rational + symbolic). Symbolic recursion at n=4,5 gives a_4 = 8 w1 w2^3 and a_5 = 16 w1 w2^5; generalizes to a_n = 2^(n-1) w1 w2^(2n-5) (A_n = i a_n). It depends only on the two minus-leg frequencies and has homogeneity degree 2n-4. Proved Re A_n = 0 from the i-parity of vertices/propagators in the recursion, and explained n=4 finiteness (off-shell BGAmplitude is a polynomial; the {2,4} 0/0 cancels). Found the amplitude is piecewise-rational (abs(k_S) chambers) and S2 x S_{n-2} symmetric; the formula is the principal-chamber piece, valid when w2 = min(free freqs) -- which contains all PI reference / pass-bar points.
work_done: code/engine.py: faithful Python port of bg.cpp (Fraction exact + sympy symbolic with per-chamber abs resolution); validated exactly vs ./bg on the full PI reference table.
code/symbolic.py, analyze.py: symbolic BGAmplitude at n=4,5; on-shell reduction -> a_4=8 w1 w2^3, a_5=16 w1 w2^5.
Conjecture a_n = 2^(n-1) w1 w2^(2n-5); derivation in derivations/derivation.md.
code/final_verify.py: EXACT verification at n=5,6,7 (residual identically 0) over many points incl. extreme regimes and shuffled plus legs; n=4 via delta->0 limit -> -24,-320,-80,-1512.
Established Re A_n=0 (recursion i-parity argument; symbolic Re identically 0 at n=4,5).
Established n=4 finiteness via off-shell polynomial continuation.
Mapped the chamber structure: formula holds iff w2 = min(free freqs); depends only on minus pair within chamber.
candidate_formula: A_n = i * 2^(n-1) * omega_1 * omega_2^(2n-5)  (principal chamber: legs 1,2 are sigma=-1; omega_2 = smallest free freq; omega_1,omega_n fixed by Sum omega=0, Sum sigma omega^2=0)

verification.method: exact rational (Fraction) port, cross-validated against ./bg; n=4 by desingularizing delta->0 limit
